name: linkget
title: Linkget
description: Save post photos, videos, audio, and offline articles via Linkget.
author: popcornnnnnnnn

commands.name: save-link
commands.title: Save Link
commands.subtitle: Linkget
commands.description: Paste a link to save pics and videos to Photos, articles to Downloads, audio, or background reads

commands.name: status-board
commands.title: Status Board
commands.subtitle: Linkget
commands.description: Browse recent downloads and saved articles, inspect CLI health, engines, sessions, and stage cleanup

preferences.name: linkgetPath
preferences.title: Linkget Binary Path
preferences.description: Path to the installed linkget CLI binary (default: /opt/homebrew/bin/linkget).

preferences.name: defaultArticleFolder
preferences.title: Default Article Archive Folder
preferences.description: Default folder for offline article archives (defaults to ~/Downloads when unset).

preferences.name: defaultMediaFolder
preferences.title: Default Media & Audio Folder
preferences.description: Optional folder for photos and videos (leave blank to save pics and videos to Apple Photos; audio defaults to ~/Downloads).

preferences.name: defaultBrowser
preferences.title: Default Browser Session
preferences.description: Browser session source passed to linkget.

preferences.name: autoDetectClipboard
preferences.title: Auto-Detect Clipboard URL
preferences.description: Automatically pre-fill the URL field from the clipboard when opening Save Link.
preferences.label: Pre-fill URL from clipboard when opening Save Link
